APPROVE
`AnswersOnlyConstants` is now a single ternary dispatch, far below 15. The extracted `IsPayloadCall` keeps the same short-circuit order; its added `k > 0` guard is always true in the expression loop, since `k` starts at `body.Start + 1`. The merged `if` conditions are logically equivalent, and every identifier the moved code uses (`f`, `t`, `body`, `response`, `locals`) is in scope in the new helpers, so the build should hold. I couldn't find the source file locally, so the sixteen unchanged lines between the two hunks are an assumption: they must not reference `parameters`, which no longer exists there.
